Falcons vs Packers DraftKings Showdown Picks: Thursday Night Football NFL DFS Captains, Projections and Sim Plays

DraftKings Showdown · Thursday Night Football, September 24 · NFL Week 3 · By Chris Spags · · Numbers as of September 24, 10:20 AM ET

Bijan Robinson carries the highest SPAGS model projection in Thursday Night Football's Falcons at Packers DraftKings Showdown slate: 20.1 DraftKings points at an $11,800 FLEX salary, or 30.1 at captain for $17,700. Robinson holds the largest share of simulated winning-lineup credit at 73% across 100,000 simulations, including the largest captain share at 26.6%.

Behind Robinson, the next four projections are Jordan Love (16.3, $10,000), Michael Penix Jr. (15.5, $9,000), Christian Watson (14.1, $9,800) and Matthew Golden (12.4, $7,800). Green Bay is a 4.5-point favorite in a game totaled at 42.5, with implied team totals of 23.5 for the Packers and 19 for the Falcons.

Every projection below is a SPAGS model estimate from the September 24, 10:20 AM ET run of the Splash Play NFL model. Winning-lineup and captain credit come from 100,000 simulations of the Showdown contest, and tied winning entries share credit. A player's simulated floor is his 10th-percentile score and his ceiling is his 95th. Showdown lineups use one captain, who scores 1.5x at 1.5x salary, and five FLEX players.

Chris Spags' latest NFL DFS breakdown on the Splash Play NFL channel.

TNF Showdown captain picks: who the sim wins with

Captain: Bijan Robinson, ATL RB ($11,800 FLEX / $17,700 CPT)

Bijan Robinson holds 26.6% of the simulated winning-lineup credit as a captain, more than any other player in this game. At captain he costs $17,700 and the 20.1-point SPAGS model projection becomes 30.1 with the 1.5x captain multiplier. The model gives him 14.6 carries and 5.6 targets. The current projection of 20.1 compares with a saved model baseline of 21.3. Across 100,000 simulations Robinson averaged 20.1 points with a simulated floor of 7.8 and a ceiling of 38.5. He holds 73% of the simulated winning-lineup credit: 26.6% as the captain and 46.2% in a FLEX spot.

Captain: Jordan Love, GB QB ($10,000 FLEX / $15,000 CPT)

Jordan Love holds 11.5% of the simulated winning-lineup credit as a captain. At captain he costs $15,000 and the 16.3-point SPAGS model projection becomes 24.4 with the 1.5x captain multiplier. Across 100,000 simulations Love averaged 16.3 points with a simulated floor of 6.3 and a ceiling of 29.5. He holds 67% of the simulated winning-lineup credit: 11.5% as the captain and 55.8% in a FLEX spot.

Captain: Christian Watson, GB WR ($9,800 FLEX / $14,700 CPT)

Christian Watson holds 10.4% of the simulated winning-lineup credit as a captain. At captain he costs $14,700 and the 14.1-point SPAGS model projection becomes 21.2 with the 1.5x captain multiplier. The model gives him 7.7 targets on 28.4 routes. Across 100,000 simulations Watson averaged 14.1 points with a simulated floor of 4.8 and a ceiling of 29.2. He holds 48% of the simulated winning-lineup credit: 10.4% as the captain and 38.0% in a FLEX spot.
